policy: Snakey only builds pinned upstream source in CI; no firmware flashing, device deployment, or physical-console writes are performed.

sources.name: Vita Linux Next
sources.license: MIT (outer integration repository); submodules retain their own licenses
sources.notes: Pinned public upstream snapshot. Its own workflow documents Bootlin ARMv7 cross-build, kernel DTBs, zImage and staged artifacts. Snakey CI reproduces that build as an upstream integration artifact, not as an original Snakey kernel.

sources.name: Linux 4 Switch / L4T Fedora
sources.notes: Maintained Switch/Tegra X1 Linux distribution is documented by its maintainer. Exact source repositories, revision pins, and redistribution licenses must be audited before CI integration.

sources.name: 3DS-Linux
sources.license: Per upstream kernel, loader and Buildroot components; audit required
sources.notes: Project reports Linux TTY, framebuffer and X11 support. Pin exact kernel/loader commits and license inventory before adding a build job.

sources.name: Wii-Linux
sources.notes: Keep as secondary research lane until a maintained source repository and reproducible toolchain are verified.
